title: iCloud Drive folder
whyItMatters: iCloud for Windows keeps a local copy of iCloud Drive files in the user profile. Those copies can contain photos and documents even after the account is signed out.
source: Apple Support, iCloud for Windows user guide: iCloud Drive files are available in the iCloud Drive folder in File Explorer - https://support.apple.com/guide/icloud-windows/welcome/1.0/icw
notes: Only exists while iCloud for Windows is installed and signed in. Photos, bookmarks and mail caches live in separate app folders and are not covered here. Online-only files may not be present locally.

cleanup.exportFirst: Copy any file that exists only in the local iCloud Drive folder to a drive you keep.
cleanup.signOut: Sign out of iCloud in the iCloud for Windows app, so the account stops syncing this PC.
steps: Confirm the files you need are copied somewhere safe.
Quit iCloud for Windows from the notification area.
Sign out in the iCloud for Windows app.
Uninstall iCloud from Settings > Apps > Installed apps.
Delete the folder named in the plan if it is still there.
cleanup.risk: Local copies leave this PC. Files still in iCloud are untouched, and files that were never downloaded are not affected.
cleanup.source: Apple Support, iCloud for Windows user guide: https://support.apple.com/guide/icloud-windows/welcome/1.0/icw
